description: The Six to Ten of Pentacles in tarot: upright and reversed meanings for generosity, patience, craft, self-sufficiency and legacy, as prompts for reflection.
lede: The Six to Ten of Pentacles cover giving, patience, skill, comfort and legacy, the steadier and more settled half of the earth suit.

faces.alt: Five original gold-linework tarot card faces in a row, Six to Ten of Pentacles in order. Each shows its number and a pentacle icon, with the card name beneath. There are no scenes or published artwork.
faces.caption: The second half of the suit moves from sharing to staying power. Read each card as a question about how you tend what you have.
